testsuite.name: com.crush.mobile.ui.screens.settings.SettingsContentTest

testcase.name: adding a key keeps Save disabled until text and dispatches the trimmed key
a failed save leaves the draft and the editor in place
the reasoning choice dispatches the off mode
delete asks for confirmation naming the provider and dismiss does nothing
a top-level destination has no back control
the missing-key line names the provider and uses a valid article
a stored key shows the hint and offers replace and delete
theme and keyboard choices dispatch their modes
providers render their names hints and stored-badge state
auto-approve asks first names the consequences and cancels to ASK
save keeps the editor and draft until the result callback succeeds
choosing a provider dispatches its id
a save error reaches the snackbar
tuning shows auto and manual truth and dispatches an override
turning auto-approve off is immediate and needs no dialog
the permission switch dispatches the auto-approve mode
